questions.question: What is the purpose of an IP address?

answers.a: To provide a physical address for a device.
answers.b: To uniquely identify a device on a network.
answers.c: To convert binary data into text.

questions.question: What is dotted decimal notation used for?

answers.a: To make IP addresses more readable for humans.
answers.b: To convert decimal numbers to binary.
answers.d: To separate the Network ID from the Host ID.
